name: The Tome of Valor
summary: At the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind, word returns that Daphne Stilwell is safe. After defending her Westfall homestead from bandits, an aspiring paladin reports to Duthorian Rall, completing the Church of the Holy Light's trials of valor. The Church's charge is to shield the innocent without thought for oneself.

sections.title: A Sacred Shield
sections.body: Daphne Stilwell's homestead in Westfall is safe after an initiate of the Church of the Holy Light defended it from bandits. Back at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind, the aspiring paladin reports her safety to Duthorian Rall. The defense shows the courage and conviction expected of one who stands between danger and the defenseless.

sections.title: Ties Between Kingdoms
sections.body: Daphne's husband, Jordan Stilwell, is in Ironforge, where he lends his renowned craftsmanship to the Alliance. With Daphne safe and the homestead guarded, Duthorian Rall prepares to send word north to Jordan. Reassured that his family is protected, the artisan can focus on his work. Their distant homes are bound by the aid the Alliance gives across its lands.

faq.answer: Duthorian Rall is a senior paladin trainer at Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He guides young paladins through spiritual and martial trials, teaching valor, righteousness, and humility.

faq.q: Why was Daphne Stilwell in danger?
faq.answer: Daphne Stilwell was in danger because bandits besieged her isolated Westfall farm. Her husband, Jordan, was away working in Ironforge.
Jordan Stilwell is Daphne's husband, a skilled blacksmith and craftsman. He is in Ironforge, helping the Alliance with his work while the Church protects his wife at home.

faq.q: What is the Tome of Valor?
faq.answer: The Tome of Valor is a holy book of lessons tied to practical trials given by the Cathedral of Light. Through them, paladins prove their courage in facing darkness and protecting the vulnerable at personal risk.

faq.q: What comes after completing this trial?
aliases: next quest after tome of valor
faq.answer: After Duthorian Rall acknowledges your defense of Daphne Stilwell, he guides you toward the Test of Righteousness, the next step in your spiritual and martial progression.

faq.q: Why does the Church care about the Stilwell homestead?
faq.answer: The Church cares about the Stilwell homestead because Daphne and Jordan have aided it through faithful service and craftsmanship. Protecting Daphne while Jordan is away honors the Church's promise to care for its own.

angles.text: As a paladin, reporting to Duthorian Rall completes your lesson in valor and shows the selflessness expected of a holy protector of the Alliance.

As an Alliance member, you can see how the Stilwell family's troubles connect Westfall's human farmlands with Ironforge's dwarven workshops. Their story shows how the Alliance depends on aid between distant lands.
